snippet.title: WheelMates Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
WheelMates launches September 1 with Friend’s Pass! 

WheelMates is a co-op driving adventure where two players pilot tiny RC cars through the house of an eccentric scientist. Team up to solve puzzles, explore hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside the house.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3905450/WheelMates/
Join discord:  https://discord.gg/rASgnFYbY
